topic: get a smooth paint finish without visible brush marks
core_question: How do I paint a wall smoothly without leaving brush or roller marks?
answer_summary: Use a good roller with appropriate nap, apply thin even coats in a W or M pattern, keep a wet edge to avoid lap marks, and lightly back-roll to even out the finish.
